text:
:= by
  let m := n * (n + 1) * (n + 2)
  have h1 : 2 ∣ m :=
    by
      suffices : 2 ∣ n ∨ 2 ∣ (n + 1) ∨ 2 ∣ (n + 2)
        by rw [dvd_mul_right, dvd_mul_left, dvd_mul_left]
      exact or.intro_left (or.intro_left (or.intro_left false) false) (dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr (mod_eq_zero 2 n))
  have h2 : 3 ∣ m :=
    by
      suffices : 3 ∣ n ∨ 3 ∣ (n + 1) ∨ 3 ∣ (n + 2)
        by rw [dvd_mul_right, dvd_mul_left, dvd_mul_left]
      exact or.intro_left (or.intro_left (or.intro_left false) false) (dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr (mod_eq_zero 3 n))
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 h2) 6 2 3
